title: More Vanilla Recipes!
description: Adds A lot more vanilla recipes to the game. It's a data pack too!
body:
This datapack adds more vanilla recipies to the game! There Are currently 11 new recipes for different things! To see them go to the images tab! 

The Current Recipes Are The Flint Recipe, Glowstone dust, gunpowder, heavy core, and more!
This is a data pack so it can be installed to minecraft without a modloader on vanilla software!
